stemMd: A machine processes 180 units in 45 minutes at a constant rate. How many minutes are needed for 300 units?
explanationMd: The rate is 4 units per minute. Processing 300 units therefore takes 300/4=75 minutes.

distractorRationale.a: Assumes an unsupported rate of 5 per minute.
distractorRationale.c: Confuses the extra units with the required minutes.
distractorRationale.d: Adds the unit increase directly to time.
